from snail_next_probe import *
from dataclasses import replace,asdict
import capstone,tempfile


def encoded(name,text):
    config=m.load_scratch_config(ROOT/'tools/match/scratches'/name)
    manifest=m.load_function_symbol_manifest(m.DEFAULT_FUNCTION_SYMBOL_MANIFEST_PATH)
    image_path=ROOT/manifest.primary_target
    start,end=m.resolve_function_extent(manifest,config.function,config.end_va)
    target=m.load_image(image_path,manifest.image_base).function_bytes(start,end)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='snail-encoded-',dir='/private/tmp') as tmp:
        path=Path(tmp)
        (path/'scratch.cpp').write_text(text)
        shadow=replace(config,directory=path)
        obj=m.compile_scratch(shadow)
        candidate=m.extract_object_function(m.parse_coff_object(obj.read_bytes()),config.symbol or config.function,reference_manifest=m.load_default_reference_symbol_manifest())
        result=m.run_match(obj_path=obj,function_name=config.function,image_path=image_path,manifest=manifest,symbol_name=config.symbol,end_va=config.end_va)
        a=bytearray(target); b=bytearray(candidate.data)
        md=capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_X86,capstone.CS_MODE_32);md.detail=True
        audited=[]
        consumed=set()
        for entry in result.masked_operand_audit.entries:
            assert entry.status=='ok'
            assert entry.target_index==entry.candidate_index
            assert entry.target_offset==entry.candidate_offset
            left_refs=entry.target_references;right_refs=entry.candidate_references
            assert len(left_refs)==len(right_refs)
            for x,y in zip(left_refs,right_refs):
                assert x.kind==y.kind and x.operand_index==y.operand_index
                assert x.explained and y.explained
                assert m._reference_status((x,),(y,),strict=True)=='ok',(x,y)
                assert y.source=='reloc'
                ti=result.target_disassembly[entry.target_index];ci=result.candidate_disassembly[entry.candidate_index]
                left=next(md.disasm(bytes(a[ti.offset:ti.offset+ti.size]),ti.offset))
                right=next(md.disasm(bytes(b[ci.offset:ci.offset+ci.size]),ci.offset))
                field='imm' if x.kind=='imm' else 'disp'
                off=getattr(left,field+'_offset');size=getattr(left,field+'_size')
                assert size==4 and off==getattr(right,field+'_offset') and size==getattr(right,field+'_size')
                assert ci.offset+off in candidate.relocation_offsets
                consumed.add(ci.offset+off)
                a[ti.offset+off:ti.offset+off+size]=bytes(size)
                b[ci.offset+off:ci.offset+off+size]=bytes(size)
                audited.append({'instruction':entry.target_index,'offset':ti.offset+off,'size':size,'key':x.key})
        # Resolve local calls only after checking the destination identity.
        reloc={r.offset for r in candidate.relocation_references}
        for line in result.candidate_disassembly:
            local=m._local_branch_offsets(line)
            if not local:continue
            ins=next(md.disasm(candidate.data[line.offset:line.offset+line.size],line.offset))
            if line.offset+ins.imm_offset not in reloc:continue
            assert len(local)==1
            off=line.offset+ins.imm_offset;size=ins.imm_size
            consumed.add(off)
            value=(local[0]-line.offset-line.size)%(1<<(size*8))
            b[off:off+size]=value.to_bytes(size,'little')
        target_end=result.target_disassembly[-1].offset+result.target_disassembly[-1].size
        candidate_end=result.candidate_disassembly[-1].offset+result.candidate_disassembly[-1].size
        assert consumed=={off for off in candidate.relocation_offsets if off<candidate_end}
        diffs=[i for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a[:target_end],b[:candidate_end])) if x!=y]
        return {'target_bytes':bytes(a[:target_end]).hex(),'candidate_bytes':bytes(b[:candidate_end]).hex(),
                'raw_candidate':candidate.data.hex(),'raw_target':target.hex(),'target_length':target_end,'candidate_length':candidate_end,
                'different_byte_offsets':diffs,'positional_references':audited,'diagnostics':m.match_result_payload(result),
                'diff':result.diff_lines}


if __name__=='__main__':
    name='initialize_slalomdouble_path_template_pair'
    rows=[]
    for label in ['baseline','baseline-array-deltas','baseline-width-ref','returned-z-array-deltas']:
        s=(OUT/name/'phase-owners'/f'{label}.cpp').read_text()
        try:
            e=encoded(name,s)
            rows.append({'label':label,**e})
            print(label,len(e['different_byte_offsets']),e['different_byte_offsets'],flush=True)
        except AssertionError as e:print(label,'audit failed',str(e)[:200],flush=True)
    (OUT/name/'encoded-controls.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from snail import match as m

ROOT = Path('/Users/banteg/dev/banteg/snail-mail')
OUT = Path('/private/tmp/snail-next-20260912')
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)


def source(name):
    return (ROOT / 'tools/match/scratches' / name / 'scratch.cpp').read_text()


def replace_once(s, old, new):
    assert s.count(old) == 1, (s.count(old), old[:100])
    return s.replace(old, new, 1)


def function(s, name):
    start = s.index('static __forceinline', s.index(name) - 45)
    opening = s.index('{', start)
    depth = 1
    end = opening + 1
    while depth:
        depth += (s[end] == '{') - (s[end] == '}')
        end += 1
    return s[start:end]


def run(name, variants, batch):
    config = m.load_scratch_config(ROOT / 'tools/match/scratches' / name)
    directory = OUT / name / batch
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    rows = []
    for label, text in variants:
        f = directory / (label + '.cpp')
        f.write_text(text)
        matches = []
        status = m.evaluate_source_overlay(config, text, on_match=matches.append)
        row = {'label': label, 'source': text,
               'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),
               'status': m.scratch_status_payload(status)}
        if matches:
            row['diagnostics'] = m.match_result_payload(matches[0])
            row['diff'] = matches[0].diff_lines
        rows.append(row)
        (directory / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + '\n')
        print(label, status.ratio, f'{status.candidate_instructions}/{status.target_instructions}',
              'prefix', status.prefix_instructions, 'exact', status.body_byte_exact,
              'refs', status.masked_ok, status.masked_unresolved, status.masked_mismatches,
              status.masked_unaudited, 'error', status.error, flush=True)
    return rows
